newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.67 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.67 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 9.0 trillion lire 10-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.67 percent, compared with 7.38 percent at the previous repo tender on December 16, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.76 percent against 7.58 percent at the last repurchase pact for 14.0 trillion lire and 17 days.
The pact covers purchases today and Tuesday and the securities are for resale on January 2. The Bank said it received 32 bids of which 17 were met in full and one in part.
